svg.aria-label: Multitenancy with a cell-based architecture. A thin routing layer maps each tenant to a cell. Each cell is a complete, independent copy of the stack, with its own services and database, serving a group of small tenants; a very large tenant can get a cell of its own. A bad deploy or overload in one cell affects only that cell's tenants, and cells can be upgraded one at a time.
